# Algorithyum — Custom Software, ERP, Mobile Apps & AI Solutions

> Algorithyum is a software development company. We build custom software, ERP systems, web applications, mobile apps (Android & iOS), games, AI-powered integrations, and help businesses grow with SEO services.

## Primary Entities & Corporate Information
- **Name**: Algorithyum
- **Website**: https://algorithyum.in
- **Core Domain**: Custom Software Development, ERP Systems, Mobile Apps, AI Integration, SEO
- **Contact**: info@algorithyum.in

## Core Capability Pillars

### 1. Custom Software Development
- **Overview**: Custom business software, SaaS products, business management applications, and backend API development built with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

### 2. ERP System Development
- **Overview**: Custom ERP software development including Manufacturing ERP, Inventory Management Systems, CRM Software, HRMS Software, School ERP, Hospital ERP, Warehouse Management Systems, Retail ERP, Billing Software, POS Software, and Business Management Software.

### 3. Software Redesign & Modernization
- **Overview**: Legacy software modernization, code refactoring, interface redesign, and database migration to improve speed and reliability.

### 4. Web Development
- **Overview**: Fast, responsive business websites, web applications, and e-commerce platforms built with Next.js and React.

### 5. Mobile App Development (Android, iOS & Cross Platform)
- **Overview**: Mobile app development for Android and iOS using native tools or cross-platform frameworks (Flutter & React Native).

### 6. Game Development
- **Overview**: Casual and 2D mobile game development for Android and iOS devices.

### 7. AI Integration & Automation
- **Overview**: Integrating OpenAI APIs, LangChain, custom AI chatbots, document processing, and automated workflows into business software.

### 8. SEO Services
- **Overview**: Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Local SEO, and search visibility optimization to help businesses rank higher on Google.

## Technologies Used
- Frontend & Mobile: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Flutter, React Native
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Python, Go
- Databases & AI: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, OpenAI, LangChain
